title: sideritis scordioides subsp. hirtula
intro: Sideritis scordioides subsp. hirtula, commonly known as Mountain tea, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions, including respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Sideritis scordioides subsp. hirtula include its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-spasmodic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable herbal remedy.
